instruction: Before attempting any code modification, you must consult .agent_manifest.json to identify the architectural pattern and the specific files responsible for data flow. Do not guess file paths.
maintenance_rule: At the end of each development session, agents MUST update .agent_manifest.json if any new features, files, repositories, database models, or architectural components were added, modified, or removed.

architectural_overview.pattern: Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF) + MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) + Repository Pattern + Clean Architecture
architectural_overview.dependency_injection: Manual DI via AppContainer.kt (owned by RfReaprApplication.container; lazy, process-lifetime repositories with the Application context). MainActivity pulls them with local delegates (`val x by container::x`) and passes them into ViewModels via viewModel { } factories. Workers reach the container via (applicationContext as RfReaprApplication).container.
architectural_overview.persistence: Room Database (AppDatabase v18, SQLite; schemas exported to app/schemas/, AutoMigrations 16->17 and 17->18, destructive fallback ONLY from legacy v1-15) + EncryptedSharedPreferences (SettingsRepositoryImpl; also holds main-menu favorites under 'favorite_tools') + plain prefs: engagement_prefs (active project id), network_watch, wol_targets
architectural_overview.migration_rules: Every schema change MUST bump AppDatabase.VERSION and add an AutoMigration/Migration; rebuild so app/schemas/<version>.json is exported and commit it; extend app/src/androidTest/.../data/db/AppDatabaseMigrationTest.kt. KSP2 is enabled in gradle.properties (ksp.useKSP2=true) because Room's schema reader fails under KSP1.
architectural_overview.network: Retrofit 2 + Gson + OkHttpClient for external APIs (Shodan, HIBP, NVD, etc.)
architectural_overview.background_processing: WorkManager (VulnerabilityUpdateWorker, RecycleBinWorker) + ScanForegroundService (promotes scans to Android Foreground Service via ActiveTaskMonitor; type dataSync, plus location ONLY while the SURVEY_TASK_NAME task is active and fine location is granted - see ScanForegroundService.promote)
architectural_overview.native_code: C++ / JNI iperf3 wrapper compiled via CMake with custom Android longjmp patch in app/src/main/cpp/iperf_android/
architectural_overview.foss_compliance: Strict 100% FOSS. Zero proprietary SDKs (No Google Play Services/GMS, Ads, Billing, ML Kit, Firebase, or Analytics).
architectural_overview.lint: gradle.properties sets android.experimental.lint.version (newer lint than the one bundled with AGP 8.7.3). The bundled lint crashed in the Compose 1.9 / Lifecycle 2.9 detectors (IncompatibleClassChangeError on Ka* analysis-API classes). Do NOT 'fix' such crashes by disabling checks; drop the property once AGP itself is upgraded. `:app:lintDebug` must pass with 0 errors.

package_map.cpp_native: app/src/main/cpp/ (iperf3 C++ submodule, iperf_android patches, CMakeLists.txt)

daos.surveyDao: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/db/dao/SurveyDao.kt (v18; geotagged survey sessions/observations AND floor-plan site surveys/samples)

entities: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/db/entity/SurveyEntities.kt (v18; survey_sessions, survey_observations [unique (sessionId, kind, identifier), FK cascade], site_surveys, site_survey_samples [FK cascade])
database_map.v18_columns: evidence.sha256 (capture hash, nullable; backfilled at app start by EvidenceRepository.backfillHashes) and evidence.findingId (nullable link to findings.id, no FK: unlinked by FindingRepositoryImpl.delete/deleteAll and EvidenceRepositoryImpl.purgeProject)
database_map.project_purge: EvidenceRepositoryImpl.purgeProject is the single place that removes everything tagged with a project (no FK cascades): evidence files, folders, findings, logs, audit_runs, known_devices, survey sessions, site surveys + floor plan files. Add any new per-project table there.
database_map.v17_columns: event_logs.projectId, scan_sessions.projectId (nullable, stamped by LogRepositoryImpl/ScanSessionRepositoryImpl from ActiveProjectStore); evidence_projects.scope (newline-separated, see ScopeMatcher)

evidence_integrity_and_finding_links.summary: Evidence gets a SHA-256 at capture/import (EvidenceRepositoryImpl.saveEvidence; re-hashed after stego embedding) and can be attached to one finding. Integrity is re-checked on display, in exports and in reports.
ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/compliance/EvidenceIntegrityRow.kt (shared hash + status row; used by the gallery detail dialog and the finding detail)

compliance_mapping.summary: Findings are mapped to compliance controls by tool + title keywords. Suggestion only: a control is never marked automatically.
compliance_mapping.domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ComplianceCatalog.kt (ComplianceCatalog = the ONLY static control list, used by ComplianceRepositoryImpl and ReportRepositoryImpl; ControlTheme; ComplianceMapper)
compliance_mapping.ui: AuditChecklistScreen.ControlItem(relatedFindings, onApplySuggestion); ComplianceViewModel(repository, findingRepository).findingsByControl; chips in FindingsScreen.FindingDetail
compliance_mapping.notes: New FindingTools need a branch in ComplianceMapper.themes. New controls go in ComplianceCatalog and, if a theme should point at them, ControlTheme.controlIds (EngagementExtensionsTest checks they exist).

audit_history.route: Screen.AuditHistory ('audit_history'); opened from AuditModeScreen (History icon), EngagementScreen workspace card and the main menu. The raw log list stays at Screen.AuditLogs.
ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/audit/AuditHistoryScreen.kt (+ AuditComparisonCard shown on the Audit Mode result screen)
audit_history.repository: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/repository/AuditRunRepository.kt -> data/repository/AuditRunRepositoryImpl.kt (AppContainer.auditRunRepository; AuditEngine saves a run in its finally block when at least one check finished)
domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/AuditRunDiff.kt (AuditRunCodec = Gson tree API snapshot codec; AuditRunDiff: new/resolved/persisting/notRetested - 'resolved' requires the producing check to have run again, matched via AuditCheck.tool)

engagement_timeline.domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/TimelineBuilder.kt (merges logs, findings, evidence, scans, audit runs)

known_devices.summary: Per-project allowlist of expected devices (by MAC). Once it has entries, the Network Monitor tags other devices and records them as findings (tool FindingTools.NETWORK_MONITOR, target = MAC).
ui: DhcpMonitorScreen/DhcpMonitorViewModel (knownMacs, markKnown, markAllKnown, reportUnknownDevices after each sweep)

geotagged_survey.summary: Wardriving-style survey: passive Wi-Fi/BLE/cell logging with GPS (android.location only, no Play Services). One row per emitter per session at its strongest position. Export WiGLE CSV / KML / GPX to a user-picked file; nothing is uploaded.
geotagged_survey.repository: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/repository/SurveyRepository.kt (SurveyRepository, SiteSurveyRepository, SURVEY_TASK_NAME) -> data/repository/SurveyRepositoryImpl.kt (AppContainer.surveyRepository, process lifetime; own LocationManager/BLE/Telephony/Wi-Fi sources)
geotagged_survey.wifi_source: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/survey/WifiScanSource.kt (direct WifiManager access shared by both survey tools so they don't disturb WifiFingerprintRepository)
geotagged_survey.notes: BLUETOOTH_SCAN keeps its neverForLocation flag, so the platform filters some beacons from BLE results.

wifi_site_survey.repository: SiteSurveyRepository -> data/repository/SiteSurveyRepositoryImpl.kt (floor plans copied to filesDir/floorplans; measure() uses WifiScanSource.freshScan and rejects stale cached results)
wifi_site_survey.domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/SignalHeatmap.kt (SiteSample, HeatPoint, SignalQuality, SurveyNetwork, SignalHeatmap: IDW interpolation with no extrapolation beyond maxDistance)

gatt_inspector.summary: Read-only BLE GATT enumeration behind an explicit consent card. NEVER writes, subscribes or pairs - keep it that way (safety-sensitive).
gatt_inspector.route: Screen.GattInspector ('gatt_inspector/{address}?name={name}'), opened from BluetoothProximityFinderScreen's tracking view

nmap_import.manager: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/audit/NmapImportManager.kt (AppContainer.nmapImportManager; 25 MB cap; nodes -> ScanSessionRepository, exposures -> findings under FindingTools.NMAP)

main_menu.ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/menu/MainMenuScreen.kt (tool list, search incl. ToolkitTool.keywords and category titles, Favorites card; favorites keyed by tool NAME via SettingsViewModel.favoriteTools/toggleFavoriteTool)
main_menu.notes: Every new tool needs a ToolkitTool entry here plus a Screen route and a composable(...) in MainActivity.

feature_map.adaptive_layouts: Width >= 840dp: FindingsScreen shows list + detail panes (BoxWithConstraints; bottom sheet otherwise) and TopologyScreen shows map + device list side by side (LocalConfiguration.screenWidthDp).

audit_mode.summary: Selection-based guided audit: the user picks checks (or a preset) and AuditEngine runs them in order against the current network or a manual target list, recording every result into the shared findings store under the active project, then grades the run (A-F) and exports a Markdown report.
audit_mode.route: Screen.AuditMode ('audit_mode'); entry card ui/menu/AuditModeCard.kt under ActiveEngagementCard in MainMenuScreen. Past runs: Screen.AuditLogs ('logs/audit') = LogListScreen type 'AUDIT' (History icon in AuditModeScreen + 'Audit Mode Logs' in the Compliance tool list). Runs are not stored as records; only the current run lives in AuditEngine.state ('New audit' clears it).
ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/audit/AuditModeScreen.kt (setup: presets, check list, targets, port depth, scope toggle; run: live steps, grade, hosts, export)
audit_mode.engine: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/audit/AuditEngine.kt (AppContainer.auditEngine, process-lifetime on applicationScope; ActiveTaskMonitor task AUDIT_TASK_NAME so it survives leaving the screen and honours Stop All; records findings per host/check so cancelled runs keep partial results; saves discovered nodes/ports/SNMP to ScanSessionRepository so the Network Discovery map reflects the audit; logs type 'AUDIT')
domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/model/Audit.kt (AuditCheck enum = execution order + active/needsHosts flags, AuditPreset, PortDepth, AuditTargets, AuditConfig, AuditStepState, AuditHost, AuditRunState, AUDIT_TASK_NAME)

app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/AuditPlanner.kt (AuditPlanner: dependency resolution TLS->PORTS->DISCOVERY, Passive Mode gating, parseTargets with /24+ CIDR and a.b.c.x-y ranges, partitionByScope, tlsEndpoints; AuditScoring: weighted score + grade caps)
audit_mode.checks_to_repositories: WIFI->WifiFingerprintRepository, CAPTIVE_PORTAL->CaptivePortalRepository, DNS->DnsAuditorRepository, UPNP->UpnpScannerRepository, DISCOVERY->NetworkDiscoveryRepository, PORTS->PortScannerRepository.scan + VulnerabilityRepository, TLS->TlsCipherScannerRepository, SNMP->SnmpRepository.probeCommunity/queryDevice. To add a check: new AuditCheck entry (position = order), a run* branch in AuditEngine, and a FindingAdapters function with stable titles.

engagement_findings_scope.summary: Evidence projects double as engagements. The active project (ActiveProjectStore -> ActiveEngagement singleton) tags logs, scan sessions and findings; its scope drives ScopeWarning under target inputs.
ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/engagement/EngagementScreen.kt + EngagementViewModel.kt (project picker, scope editor, stats, exports, scan comparison)

app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/findings/FindingsScreen.kt + FindingsViewModel.kt (filter, triage status/notes, manual findings, export, overflow 'Clear all findings' -> FindingRepository.deleteAll(activeProjectId))
app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/components/ScopeWarning.kt (used by Port Scanner, Ping, Traceroute, SNMP, TLS, Website Inspector, Subdomain Finder)
domain: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/FindingAdapters.kt (tool results -> FindingDraft: ports, TLS, DNS audit, UPnP, SNMP, ARP, NFC, USB, cellular, Wi-Fi (connected network + evil twins), captive portal)

app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/FindingsExporter.kt (CSV w/ formula-injection guard, JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML, DefectDojo Generic Findings JSON; exports list related controls and linked evidence with hash + integrity)
app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/components/ExportUtils.kt (ExportFormat.render(report) / fileSuffix - add new text formats here)
engagement_findings_scope.tool_wiring: ViewModels take an optional findingRepository (PortScanner, UPnP, SNMP, TLS, DnsAuditor, NFC, ARP, CaptivePortal, and the OSINT tools Shodan, ThreatIntel, HIBP, CloudAssetScanner via their analyzers' toDrafts); AuditEngine also records via FindingAdapters. UsbOtgAuditorScreen/CellularReconScreen take onFindings callbacks (recorded only when the finding set changes). New finding-producing tools: add an adapter in FindingAdapters with STABLE titles (titles are part of the fingerprint).

encrypted_backup.manager: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/backup/BackupManager.kt (WAL checkpoint snapshot, zip of db + filesDir + wol/engagement prefs, path rewrite on restore, zip-slip guard, newer-db-version rejection; excludes settings/API keys)

background_network_watch.worker: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/worker/NetworkWatchWorker.kt (opt-in 15-min periodic, UNMETERED + battery-not-low, skips in passive mode)

network_discovery_and_topology.ui_helpers: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/topology/TopologyUi.kt (shared risk colors, DeviceType icons/names, TopologyFilter search+sort logic, NodeSortOrder, node summary text)
network_discovery_and_topology.ui_state_notes: TopologyViewModel exposes activeNodeScans (per-node scan kinds), auditProgress, deepScanCompleted, nodeResults (last per-node result shown in the sheet), and a messages Flow for snackbars. The port scanner repository is single-target, so port scans are serialized via isPortScannerBusy. All map-bound work (discovery, deep scan, per-node scans) runs in a per-session scope that resetSession() cancels-and-joins before each new discovery/clear. ScanSessionRepository.updateNodeDetails is update-only (never re-inserts a cleared node); every discovery, including AuditEngine's, replaces the map rather than merging.
network_discovery_and_topology.navigation_out: TopologyScreen -> Screen.PortScanner.createRoute(ip), Screen.ThreatIntel.createRoute(ip), and via onNavigate(route) from DeviceDetailBottomSheet: Ping, Traceroute, TLS (if a TLS port is open), SNMP. Tools accepting a prefilled target use `?target=` (Screen.withTarget; MainActivity NavBackStackEntry.targetArg()): WebsiteInspector, SubdomainFinder, TlsCipherScanner, SnmpBrowser, Traceroute.

dhcp_network_monitor.data_repository: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/repository/DhcpMonitorRepositoryImpl.kt (baseline + sweep diffing via NetworkDiscoveryRepository; offline after 2 missed sweeps)
dhcp_network_monitor.notes: Monitoring registers 'Network Monitor' with ActiveTaskMonitor so it keeps running in the foreground service while backgrounded; stops when the screen's ViewModel is cleared.

mdns_service_discovery.ui_viewmodel: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/mdns/ServiceDiscoveryViewModel.kt (60s timed browse, logs results as TOPOLOGY)

shared: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/HostValidator.kt (validate/normalize hosts before exec'ing ping etc. - prevents option injection)

repository: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/data/repository/TracerouteRepositoryImpl.kt (TTL probes + direct per-hop RTT pings + reverse DNS)

packet_capture.notes: VPN mode excludes RF-REAPR via addDisallowedApplication and records but does not forward packets. RootPcapCapture is a singleton (RootPcapCapture.get) with a validated BPF filter. Captures keep running when the screen closes.

evidence_and_compliance.deletion: Project delete = soft delete to Recycle Bin (restore/purge, auto-purge after 30 days via RecycleBinWorker). EvidenceRepositoryImpl.purgeProject also deletes the project's findings (FindingDao.deleteForProject) and logs (EventLogDao.deleteLogsForProject) since there are no FK cascades; scan sessions are kept (shared network history). EvidenceRepositoryImpl takes evidenceDao, findingDao, eventLogDao, context (AppContainer + RecycleBinWorker).

report_builder.findings: ReportBuilderViewModel(repository, initialProjectId) filters scans/logs by project and adds a Findings section (ReportData.findings: ReportFinding with controlIds + linked evidence and integrity). ReportRepositoryImpl takes findingRepository; drawEvidence (PDF) and addDocxEvidence (DOCX) render evidence with its SHA-256.

analysis_services._note: Pure-Kotlin analyzers in domain/service (no Android deps, unit-tested). Tools delegate parsing/scoring to these so the logic is testable. Added/expanded in the 2026 tool-enhancement pass.
analysis_services.port_catalog: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/PortCatalog.kt (service names, exposure notes/risk, COMMON_PORTS, parsePortSpec, webUrl) - powers PortScanner (stateless scan(host,ports,options) in PortScannerRepository + banner grabbing in PortScannerRepositoryImpl)
analysis_services.upnp: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/UpnpTools.kt (SSDP/description/SOAP/NAT-PMP parsing + findings) - UpnpScannerRepository.audit() reads IGD port mappings read-only; UpnpScannerViewModel/UpnpAuditorScreen
analysis_services.dns_audit: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/DnsAuditEvaluator.kt (sentinel/NXDOMAIN/DNSSEC/rebinding checks, CheckStatus) - DnsAuditorRepositoryImpl gathers system vs DoH; DnsAuditorViewModel/Screen rewritten to a checklist
analysis_services.captive_portal: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/CaptivePortalAnalyzer.kt - probing lives in domain/repository/CaptivePortalRepository.kt -> data/repository/CaptivePortalRepositoryImpl.kt (AppContainer.captivePortalRepository, shared with AuditEngine); CaptivePortalViewModel(repository, logRepository, findingRepository)
analysis_services.snmp: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/SnmpTools.kt (ifType/speed, vendor from sysObjectID, default-community list, findings) - SnmpRepositoryImpl adds probeCommunity + walk + tables (interfaces/IP/ARP); SnmpViewModel/SnmpBrowserScreen tabbed
analysis_services.arp: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ArpMonitorEvaluator.kt (+ system/NeighborTable.kt) - ArpDetectorRepositoryImpl watches gateway MAC/first-hop/DNS/BSSID; notifies via NetworkAlertNotifier.notifySecurityAlert
analysis_services.ble: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/BleAdvertisementAnalyzer.kt (tracker/beacon classification, distance) - BleScannerRepositoryImpl; BluetoothProximityFinderViewModel (trackers, following alerts, BLE session logs); model/BleDevice.kt enriched
analysis_services.wifi: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/WifiSecurityAnalyzer.kt (security family, evil-twin, channel advice, band/channel math - NOTE 6GHz channel anchored at 5945MHz+1 per WifiAccessPointTest) - WifiFingerprintRepositoryImpl (status flow, ifXTable, standard); WifiFingerprintViewModel/Screen
analysis_services.sdr: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/SdrDsp.kt (rtl_tcp header, Hann window, dBFS, peak) - RtlTcpRepositoryImpl (Hann+averaging, ~15fps, PPM/bias-T); FftData/SdrConfig enriched; WaterfallView spectrum+waterfall; SdrScreen
analysis_services.nfc: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/NfcAnalyzer.kt (NDEF decode, chip ID, findings) - NfcScannerRepositoryImpl (reader-mode gated by screen via readerRequested); NfcTagData enriched; NfcScannerViewModel logs NFC
analysis_services.magnetometer: MagnetometerViewModel calibrated baseline/deviation + history + optional beep; MagnetometerRepository exposes accuracy/isAvailable
analysis_services.usb: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/UsbAuditAnalyzer.kt (class names, attack-board VID:PID, BadUSB findings) - UsbOtgAuditorScreen polls deviceList
analysis_services.cellular: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/CellAnalyzer.kt (LTE/NR band+freq, IMSI-catcher/2G-downgrade findings) - CellularReconScreen (requestCellInfoUpdate, all RATs)
analysis_services.ducky: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/DuckyScriptValidator.kt (lint + duration estimate) - surfaced in HidInjectorScreen below the editor
analysis_services.tls: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/TlsAnalyzer.kt (protocol/cipher grading, overall grade, key/sig risk) - TlsCipherScannerRepositoryImpl (one handshake/protocol + cipher enumeration + certificate inspection); TlsScanResult/ProtocolSupport/CertificateInfo; also reused by CertDecoderScreen
analysis_services.web: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/WebSecurityAnalyzer.kt (SecurityHeaderAnalyzer: A-F header grade + cookie/CORS checks, used by WebsiteInspectorRepositoryImpl; SubdomainTakeoverAnalyzer: dangling-CNAME hints, used by SubdomainFinderRepositoryImpl via Cloudflare DoH CNAME lookups). WebsiteInspectorViewModel and SubdomainFinderViewModel take findingRepository (FindingTools.WEB / SUBDOMAIN). The remaining OSINT tools were reworked in the same pass, see 'osint'.

osint._note: Every OSINT tool delegates parsing / judging to a pure analyzer here. API responses are parsed with the Gson TREE API (never reflection: Gson fills Kotlin non-null fields with null when a key is missing). Online lookups run only on an explicit tap.
osint.public_ip_guard: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ThreatIntelAnalyzer.kt -> PublicIpGuard (hand-written IPv4/IPv6 literal check, NEVER does DNS). Shodan, InternetDB and AbuseIPDB lookups refuse private / loopback / link-local addresses locally so internal addressing is not leaked to third parties. Reuse it for any new reputation/recon service.
osint.threat_intel: ThreatIntelAnalyzer.kt (AbuseIpDbParser, ThreatIntelAnalyzer: verdict levels, AbuseIPDB category names, findings under FindingTools.THREAT_INTEL when score >= 25). ThreatIntelViewModel(repository, settings, logRepository, findingRepository); log type 'THREAT_INTEL'.
osint.shodan: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ShodanAnalyzer.kt (ShodanParser for host/search/InternetDB/error bodies; ShodanAnalyzer: risky-port exposures via PortCatalog, findings under FindingTools.SHODAN, clipboard summaries, and hostLog/searchLog/internetDbLog whose KEY NAMES are a stored format read by ReportRepositoryImpl). ShodanRepositoryImpl builds URLs with HttpUrl (query is encoded; never surface OkHttp error text because the URL carries the API key). ShodanViewModel has search pagination (loadMore).
osint.breaches: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/BreachAnalyzer.kt (HibpParser, BreachAnalyzer: per-breach severity, summary + advice, findings under FindingTools.BREACH; PwnedPasswords: k-anonymity range matching). HibpRepository.pwnedPasswordCount needs NO API key and sends only the 5-char SHA-1 prefix; the password must never be logged, saved to instance state or put in a finding. Account lookup keeps breach results when the paste lookup fails and honours one short Retry-After.
osint.cloud_assets: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/CloudBucketAnalyzer.kt (CloudProvider, CloudBucketPlanner: candidate names + probe URLs, CloudBucketClassifier: provider answers -> BucketState, findings under FindingTools.CLOUD only for anonymously listable assets). CloudAssetScannerRepositoryImpl: 10 concurrent cancellable probes, follows S3's x-amz-bucket-region once, probes common container names on Azure accounts that exist. CloudAsset.platform/url/status are stored-log keys read by ReportRepositoryImpl. A domain passed from Subdomain Finder is prefilled, never auto-scanned.
osint.usernames: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/UsernameCheckEvaluator.kt + domain/model/UsernameSite.kt (UsernameSitesDatabase with per-site UsernameDetection STATUS_CODE / BODY_PRESENT / BODY_ABSENT, username patterns, UsernameStatus incl. UNCERTAIN for blocked checks). Every site rule was checked against a known and a nonexistent account on 2026-11-24; do not add a site whose rule you have not verified both ways (soft 404s make 'HTTP 200 = found' wrong). Log type 'USERNAME'.
osint.phone: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/PhoneNumberAnalyzer.kt (full ITU calling-code table, NANP area-code countries, trunk-prefix rules, validity, line-type estimate, search variants + exact-match query, lookup links). PhoneOsintViewModel is a thin wrapper; fully offline.
osint.dorks: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/DorkQueryBuilder.kt (SearchEngine, target normalisation, scoping) + domain/model/GoogleDork.kt (DorkScope: SITE prefixes site:target, KEYWORD appends the quoted target for dorks that already search a third-party site; OsintToolsTest enforces that scope matches the query).
osint.exif: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ExifPrivacyAnalyzer.kt (privacy findings, editing indicators, DMS / GPS-time formatting, text report). ExifRepositoryImpl reads tags by EXIF tag NAME (rawTags keys), hashes the file, and stripMetadata re-encodes with a memory-safe sample size then re-reads the copy to verify it is clean (SanitizedImage.remainingTags); saveSanitized writes to a SAF document.
osint.payloads: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/PayloadCodec.kt (PayloadCodec: 11 formats, lenient decode, format detection; JwtAnalyzer: claims, security findings, HS256/384/512 secret verification). PayloadEncoderViewModel is a thin wrapper.
osint.reverse_shells: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/ReverseShellCatalog.kt (templates, listeners, TTY upgrade steps, strict host/port validation so input cannot alter a generated command, URL-encoded form). Safety-sensitive: keep it a reference of standard public one-liners; do not add AV/EDR evasion or obfuscation.
osint.ui: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/ui/web/OsintUi.kt (OsintNotice, FindingsRecordedNotice, rememberCopyAction shared by the OSINT screens)
osint.tests: app/src/test/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/OsintAnalyzersTest.kt (IP guard, AbuseIPDB, Shodan, breaches, Pwned Passwords, cloud buckets, usernames) and OsintToolsTest.kt (phone, dorks, EXIF, codec, JWT, reverse shells)

analysis_services.shared: HostValidator.normalize is used by PortScanner, SNMP, TLS target parsing. SeverityBadge (ui/scanner) is the shared risk chip reused by UPnP/DNS/SNMP/USB/Cellular/TLS/NFC/Cert screens.
analysis_services.tests: app/src/test/java/com/fearmikey/rf_reapr/domain/service/{PortCatalog,UpnpTools,NetworkAuditEvaluators,WirelessAnalyzers,TlsAnalyzer,AuditMode,EngagementExtensions,SurveyAndImport}Test.kt (268 unit tests total pass as of the OSINT rework, incl. Osint{Analyzers,Tools}Test; EngagementExtensionsTest = hashing, compliance mapping, audit-run diff, timeline, known devices, HTML/DefectDojo exports; SurveyAndImportTest = survey merge/exports, heatmap, GATT, Nmap, security headers, takeover)
